<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
The user wants me to send a confirmation email for the meeting.
Alison has found a time that works for all four partners: Thursday at 12:00 PM.
My task is to send the confirmation email to the partners.
The `send_confirmation_email` function requires the day, start time, and body of the email.
- Day: "Thu"
- Start time: "12:00"
- Body: I will write a professional email confirming the meeting details.

I will then end the session as my part of the task is complete.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Excellent! I'll send the confirmation email to all partners now.
